subject: Harborline MAP — assurance checklist & retention options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ewalker@harborline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Harborline MAP — assurance checklist & retention options

Ethan, thanks again for the demo yesterday — good conversation. As promised, I pulled together the specific security/compliance items we recommend including in the MAP so Harborline can evaluate on a deterministic timeline.

High-level ask: please confirm which of the retention profiles below you'll need (we can accommodate any, but it affects DPA language and evidence packaging):
- Short (30 days token logs + 90 days request metadata)
- Standard (90 days token logs + 365 days request metadata)
- Extended (365+ days, custom escrow options)

Next steps I propose:
1) Harborline picks a retention profile by EOD Tue (2026-07-14)
2) Redwood provides SOC 2 Type II report & SIG mapping (we'll share the redacted report)
3) Legal teams exchange DPA redline (we can pre-seed language for the standard profiles)

Cc'ing Kimberly from Security to outline evidence and the CAIQ / SIG bucket we'll deliver. If you want a technical call with our security team this week, Kimberly is available Thurs morning PST.

Thanks — I can update the MAP timeline once you confirm retention preference.

--
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0197
From: Ethan Walker <ewalker@harborline.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Harborline Security <security@harborline.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Harborline MAP — assurance checklist & retention options

Marcus — appreciate the recap and the clear checklist. A couple of clarifying points from our side before we lock a profile:

1) SOC 2: will the redacted report include the complementary user-entity controls (we need to show auditors how we configure the integration)?
2) SIG/CAIQ mapping: can you identify which controls map to our data residency and key management asks? We have an internal requirement that any cloud vendor must support customer-managed keys or an HSM-backed KMS for production data.
3) DPA: our legal team tends to push for a 90-day default retention on logs, but we have a couple of product teams that may ask for 365-day traces for fraud investigations — how flexible is that in the MAP without escalating pricing?

Also — what's the expected lead time for evidence delivery (e.g., how long between profile selection and when we get the SOC2 spreadsheet + annotated CAIQ)? We're aiming to complete security review by 2026-07-28 to hit our internal procurement cycle.

If Kimberly can do a 30–40 minute call Thurs at 09:30 PT, that works for us.

Thanks,
Ethan Walker
Head of Product Security
Harborline Bank
ewalker@harborline.com | +1 (206) 555-4422
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ewalker@harborline.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Harborline MAP — assurance checklist & retention options

Ethan — thanks for the questions. Quick answers and an evidence plan so you can map to Harborline's procurement cutoff. Attachments referenced below.

1) SOC 2 / Complementary controls
- The redacted SOC 2 Type II we share includes the control objectives and the testing summary. For configuration guidance (complementary user-entity controls) we'll include a short appendix that describes how customers should configure access & key policies when using Redwood Dedicated or Private. See attached: SOC2-Redwood-2025.pdf (redacted).

2) SIG/CAIQ mapping & KMS
- We've prepared a SIG-to-CAIQ mapping spreadsheet that highlights KMS and data residency control owners and where Redwood's runtime and control plane satisfy each item. In short:
  - Hosted: server-side KMS (customer-supplied key support via KMS integration) for encryption at rest; HSM-backed key wrapping available for dedicated/private.
  - Private/VPC: customer-managed KMS or on-prem HSM supported as part of the private deployment package.
- See attached: SIG-CAIQ-mapping-harborline.xlsx (columns: control, requirement, evidence file link).

3) Retention & DPA options
- We support the three retention profiles Marcus outlined. Pricing delta between 90 and 365 days is typically driven by storage tiering and access SLA; for evaluation MAPs we can provision the 365 profile under a temporary credit so you can complete fraud/regression testing without immediate pricing impact.
- For the DPA redline, we've pre-seeded clause options for each retention tier (Section 5: Data Retention & Deletion). If you prefer a hybrid approach (90-day default, 365-day for flagged traces), we can add an annex that defines scoped retention by data type and authorized roles.
- Attached: DPA-redline-harborline.docx (redline with three profile clause options).

Evidence delivery cadence (to meet your 2026-07-28 internal cutoff):
- Day 0 (upon profile select): provide redacted SOC 2 report + SIG/CAIQ mapping (today's attachments)
- Day 2: deliver annotated evidence links for critical controls (IAM, network segmentation, KMS configuration) to your S3/secure share
- Day 5: optional 30-minute walkthrough call where we can sign off evidence ownership and acceptance criteria

Action items for Harborline before we lock MAP timeline:
- Confirm retention profile (Short / Standard / Extended) and whether you want hybrid/annex by 2026-07-14 EOD
- If you want customer-managed keys for production, flag so we can prepare a short tech-run with our infra team (this typically adds 3 business days to private deployment lead time)

If Ethan and the security team want a 09:30 PT slot on Thursday (2026-07-15), I can join and bring one of our platform engineers. Marcus — I'll leave scheduling to you.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-Redwood-2025.pdf (report, redacted stub); SIG-CAIQ-mapping-harborline.xlsx (mapping); DPA-redline-harborline.docx (redline stub)
From: Ethan Walker <ewalker@harborline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Harborline MAP — assurance checklist & retention options

Kimberly / Marcus — this is exactly what we needed, thanks. Harborline will opt for the Standard profile (90-day logs / 365-day request metadata) and we'd like the hybrid annex for flagged traces (365). Also please prep the customer-managed key notes — we want that included in the MAP as an option for production.

Confirming we are available for the Thursday 09:30 PT walkthrough — invite to follow from our sec team. If we can get the annotated evidence links by Day 2 as you outlined, we'll be able to close the security review by 2026-07-28.

I'll loop our procurement contact once the DPA redline is seeded.

—Ethan
